rulesModal.title: Custom Cleaning Rules
rulesModal.subtitle: Configure deterministic cleaning rules according to your workflow.
rulesModal.normalizeSpaces: Normalize multiple spaces into a single space
rulesModal.trimLineEnds: Trim trailing whitespace on each line
rulesModal.removeExcessBlankLines: Collapse 3+ blank lines to 1 blank line
rulesModal.fixPdfHyphenation: Reconnect PDF broken hyphenated words (e.g., imple- mentation)
rulesModal.fixPdfLineBreaks: Fix hard-wrapped sentence breaks from PDF columns
rulesModal.removePageArtifacts: Remove page numbers and header/footer lines
rulesModal.removeZeroWidthChars: Remove zero-width spaces, BOM, and invisible control codes
rulesModal.normalizeNonBreakingSpaces: Convert non-breaking spaces (NBSP) to standard spaces
rulesModal.normalizeQuotes: Normalize smart/curly quotes to standard straight quotes
rulesModal.normalizeFullWidth: Convert full-width Latin characters (Ａ-Ｚ) to ASCII
rulesModal.stripHtmlTags: Strip HTML tags while preserving text layout
rulesModal.cleanMarkdownArtifacts: Clean empty markdown tags and orphaned fences
rulesModal.cleanAiPreamble: Strip AI preambles ('Certainly! Here is...') and 'Copy code' buttons
rulesModal.preserveLists: Preserve bullet and numbered list indentations

features.sectionSubtitle: From academic papers to AI transcripts, KireiPaste cleans the mess without changing your actual words.

items.title: Smart Text Cleaner
items.desc: Removes multi-spaces, trailing junk, tab irregularities, and blank line floods with precision.

items.title: PDF Document Healer
items.desc: Reconnects hyphenated words and rejoins multi-column wrapped sentences effortlessly.

items.title: AI Output Sanitizer
items.desc: Removes conversational preambles, trapped outer code fences, and web UI copy tags.

items.title: Invisible Bug Killer
items.desc: Eliminates zero-width spaces, Unicode byte order marks, and invisible control glyphs.

items.title: Unicode Normalizer
items.desc: Harmonizes full-width characters, curly quotes, and non-breaking spaces.

items.title: Data & Table Prep
items.desc: Prepares messy copied spreadsheet columns and clipboard text for pasting.

why.subtitle: Built for writers, developers, researchers, and professionals who demand clean text.

items.title: 100% Client-Side Privacy
items.desc: Your text never leaves your browser. Zero cloud processing, zero logs, zero third-party tracking.

items.title: Zero AI Hallucinations
items.desc: Deterministic regex and Unicode algorithms. We never rewrite, summarize, or alter your meaning.

items.title: Instant Sub-Millisecond Speed
items.desc: Cleans thousands of words in under 15 milliseconds directly in JavaScript.

items.title: Smart Diff Inspection
items.desc: Easily inspect every single character, space, or line change with the interactive diff tool.
